d2.card: Division II: calls, texts and emails are allowed at any time. In-person contact and paid official visits open June 15 after sophomore year.

d3.card: Division III: paid official visits open January 1 of junior year. D3 offers no athletic scholarships; aid is academic and need-based.

ec.card: Division I: no official visit without an NCAA Eligibility Center certification account ($110 domestic, fee waivers possible). The free Profile Page is not enough.

fb.card: D1 football: coaches may start calling, texting and emailing June 15 after sophomore year.

bb.card: D1 baseball runs on a later clock: calls, texts and emails open August 1 of junior year, not June 15.

core.card: Division I: finish 10 of your 16 core courses before senior year, 7 of them in English, math and science. Those grades lock.
